name: Jeune et Jolie

menus.name: Four-course prix fixe
menus.note: A choice of dishes at each course; also served at the bar and lounge; beverage pairing $100, alcohol-free Sans Esprit pairing $80; wagyu main $55 extra

alsoTry.name: Le Menu du Bar
alsoTry.note: An à la carte menu for walk-in guests at the bar and lounge.

walkIns: Walk-ins are welcome at the bar and lounge tables every evening, where both the four-course menu and the à la carte bar menu are served.
groups: Tables seat up to eight. For a buyout of the restaurant, email bonjour@jeune-jolie.com.
byob: Corkage is $50 a bottle for the first two bottles and $75 for each one after.
